answer: Make every newcomer find a sponsor who posts a bond on its behalf. If the new agent is later proven to be one of many puppets run from the same box, the sponsor's bond is slashed too, so honest agents vouch with velvet caution. An attacker building a sybil canyon of fake accounts must either buy real sponsors at full bond price for each fake or self-sponsor with capital that burns on discovery. Like juniper roots splitting rock slowly, trust spreads only along costly, accountable links.
